about.title: About Us
about.description: Guangzhou-based synthetic thatch manufacturer — factory capacity, certifications, and global resort export experience since 2014.
about.keywords: synthetic thatch manufacturer, Guangzhou factory, B1 fire thatch, export roofing supplier, PalmGrass Pro
about.introText: PalmGrass Pro designs and manufactures extruded synthetic palm, nipa, cadjan, reed and straw thatch panels for hotels, resorts, theme parks and eco-lodges. We serve qualified B2B buyers — developers, contractors and hospitality procurement teams — with OEM profiles, fire-retardant options and export-ready packing.
about.introImageAlt: Luxury resort with synthetic thatch roofing installed by PalmGrass Pro
about.eeatExperienceText: Since 2014 our team has supplied roof systems for tropical hospitality projects across Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, the Caribbean and Europe. We understand salt-spray coastlines, high-UV climates and the documentation buyers need for tender submissions.
about.eeatExpertiseSubtitle: In-house production and technical support — not a trading desk reselling generic panels.
about.expertise1Text: Extrusion, colour batching and hand-trimmed profiles under one roof — 8,000 m² monthly panel capacity with traceable lot numbers.
about.expertise2Text: Class B1 flame-retardant formulations and UV-stable pigments; test reports from SGS and internal QC available for project files.
about.expertise3Text: FOB Guangzhou, palletized cartons with CBM data for container planning; experience shipping to 50+ countries.
about.expertise4Text: Custom lengths, colours and profile mixes; installation guidance and sample panels for architect sign-off before bulk orders.
about.whoWeServeText: We work with qualified commercial buyers only — not retail walk-ins. Typical clients:
about.eeatAuthorityText: Our product lines mirror regional thatch styles — palm, nipa, cadjan, reed, straw and makuti — so specifiers can match local architecture without natural thatch maintenance or fire risk.
about.certificatesSubtitle: Documentation available for tender packs and buyer due diligence.
about.factoryPhotosSubtitle: Real footage from our Guangzhou floor — hand assembly, machine lines, QC and export packing.
about.factorySubtitle: Completed resort and hospitality thatch roofing worldwide — not stock photography.
about.eeatTrustText: We publish our factory location, direct sales contacts and realistic lead times. Quotes include SKU specs, packing dimensions and MOQ — no hidden trading mark-ups. Request samples before container orders.
